title: Human Development - Early Childhood Education Option
sourceText:
H D 101 [SSCI]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 4 of these 5 UCORE designations: ARTS, BSCI, EQJS, HUM, PSCI. One lab science (BSCI or PSCI) must be completed.

Written Communication [WRTG]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

H D 204

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Elective
Electives must include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 40 credits of upper-division coursework. May need to include a writing in the major [M] course to meet University requirements.

H D 220

H D 306

H D 300 or 302

H D 341

H D 350 [DIVR]

Electives
Electives must include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 40 credits of upper-division coursework. May need to include a writing in the major [M] course to meet University requirements.

Complete Writing Portfolio

H D 235

H D 300, 302, or 403

H D 310 [M]

H D 482

H D 342

H D 445
H D 445 must be taken before H D 446 but no more than two semesters before H D 446.

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

H D 410

H D 446
All H D majors complete a practicum/internship experience. H D 446 is reserved for students completing the option in Early Childhood Education and requires a half-day each day, 5 days a week for a semester.

Students can be admitted as a Human Development major after completing 24 credits and earning a GPA of at least 2.0. A cumulative GPA of 2.6 or better in all H D courses that apply to the option, including substitutions is required to (a) maintain admission in the major; and (b) complete the Bachelor of Arts degree in Human Development. Of the 48-49 credits required for the major and Early Childhood Education option, a minimum of 21 must be taken at WSU.
